tools.name: get_chart_facts
tools.description: Deterministic Vedic chart facts for birth data: lagna, Moon sign/nakshatra, current dasha, planets in houses, house lords, dignities, combustions, D9/D10 ascendants, Sade Sati standing, yogas with classical-text citations, dasha timeline. Pure computation, no LLM. Same output as POST /api/b2b/chart-

tools.name: ask_jyotish
tools.description: Grounded synthesis answer to a question, computed from the birth chart through the same accuracy-gated path as the retail chat endpoint (chart-anchor check and rewrite retry inside run_reading). The response envelope carries citation_status and accuracy-gate notes. lang: en or hi (default en).

tools.name: guna_milan
tools.description: Vedic compatibility (Guna Milan / Ashtakoota) between two people, 36 points across eight kootas: varna, vashya, tara, yoni, graha_maitri, gana, bhakoot, nadi. Moon nakshatra and rashi for each native are computed from their birth data through the same chart engine as get_chart_facts — do not pass na

tools.name: get_panchang
tools.description: Panchang for a location (and optional date, default: today at that location): tithi, paksha, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vara and its lord, sunrise/sunset. Deterministic, no LLM. Same compute path as GET /api/panchang.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_chart_facts, ask_jyotish · Public sink: get_chart_facts.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_chart_facts, ask_jyotish · Public sink: get_chart_facts

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
